visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Width has no effect on a span
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This label is given a width of 100px, but it stays as wide as its text. A width does not apply to an inline element.

solution.code: Tag
solution.explanation: A span is inline by default, and inline elements ignore width and height. display: inline-block keeps the element in the line of text but lets it have a size.
